depiction.subject: Museum map of Sri Lanka during the Anuradhapura period
depiction.event_or_theme: hydraulic, monastic, political and port geography
depiction.period: modern museum representation of c. first millennium BCE–early second millennium CE
depiction.notes: The image documents modern synthesis, not contemporaneous cartography.

vision_review.visual_notes: Island map with hydrography/topography and categorical site symbols; visible legend includes canal, sub-capital, monastery site and ancient port.
vision_review.uncertainty: Fine place labels and the full legend are not all readable at current resolution.

tag_review.notes: Routed to Anuradhapura hydraulic order plus Indian Ocean bridge.

human_review.notes: Historical use requires captions to state that this is a museum synthesis.

fragment.caption: Une carte muséale de la période d’Anuradhapura : l’île apparaît comme un système où cœur hydraulique intérieur, monastères, centres secondaires et ports sont spatialement articulés.
fragment.what_it_shows: A modern spatial synthesis combining water, institutions, settlements and ports.
fragment.why_here: Makes visible the project's core thesis that Anuradhapura was inland without being isolated from maritime systems.
fragment.limits: Chronologically compresses a millennium-plus; mapped dots and lines are not simultaneous observations.

depiction.subject: Museum schematic of ancient Indian Ocean sea routes
depiction.event_or_theme: Indian Ocean connectivity and maritime technology zones
depiction.period: modern museum synthesis of ancient/early historic maritime exchange
depiction.notes: Solid lines show major sea routes; dashed and x-marked zones are labelled dhow and outrigger technology zones.

vision_review.caption_transcription: TRADE — Ancient Sea Routes; Major Sea Routes; Dhow Technology Zone; Outrigger Technology Zone
vision_review.visual_notes: Sri Lanka lies near intersecting route arcs between western Indian Ocean, India, Bay of Bengal and Southeast Asia.
vision_review.uncertainty: The panel gives no visible chronology for the technology-zone boundaries; treat them as schematic.

tag_review.notes: Routed primarily as a dezoom illustration of maritime connectivity.

human_review.notes: Do not caption dhow/outrigger boundaries as precise historical facts without specialist sourcing.

fragment.caption: Cette carte ne montre pas une “autoroute maritime” unique mais un faisceau de circuits : le Sri Lanka se trouve au point de couture entre mer d’Arabie, Inde, baie du Bengale et Asie du Sud-Est.
fragment.what_it_shows: A schematic network of major maritime routes and broad technology zones.
fragment.why_here: Provides a geographic dezoom explaining why an inland Sri Lankan kingdom could sit inside long-distance commercial systems.
fragment.limits: Route curves are schematic; technology zones are chronologically underspecified and should not be read as exclusive borders.
